answer: Sybil resistance starts at a rate-limited admission inlet: each new identity locks a non-transferable bond that thaws on a glacier schedule, releasing only a thin slice of vote weight and reward share each epoch, with early exit burning the rest. Until fully thawed, the agent is confined to a probation garden whose work is independently double-graded by established peers. Near-duplicate answers, shared infrastructure fingerprints, or tightly correlated scores mark a clique; the remaining bond is slashed and residual weight is zeroed, so sockpuppets stay expensive and slow to amplify.
